newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Hub Power gains 5.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Hub Power gains 5.1 percent.

text.p: Shares of Pakistan's Hub Power Co Ltd jumped 1.65 rupees, or 5.1 percent, to 34 on Wednesday after a 7.86 percent devaluation in the rupee, dealers said.
The stock emerged as volume leader with turnover of over 3.82 million shares in early trade.
"Hub Power and PTCL, which have GDRs (Global Depositary Receipts) have risen on devaluation," dealer Ather Raouf said. "Their local prices rose to match GDR rates abroad."
He said Hub Power stood to gain from the devaluation because its earnings were denominated in dollars.
